title: Frequency and submission
twin: The LE-1 report shall be submitted quarterly through the Authority's reporting portal within 15 calendar days of quarter end.

title: Funded exposure
twin: Funded exposure shall include all on-balance sheet assets relating to the counterparty.

title: Non-funded exposure
twin: Off-balance sheet items shall be converted to credit equivalent amounts using the Standardised Approach credit conversion factors.

title: Grouping of counterparties
twin: Counterparties shall be treated as a group of connected counterparties where one controls the other, or where they are economically interdependent.

title: Eligible capital base
twin: The eligible capital base shall be the Tier 1 capital reported in the most recent capital adequacy return.

title: Reporting threshold
twin: The report shall include every counterparty or group with exposure at or above 10 percent of eligible capital base, plus the 20 largest exposures.

title: Exempt exposures
twin: Exposures to the central government and central bank shall be reported and marked as exempt from limits.

title: Collateral
twin: Exposure value may be reduced by eligible cash and government securities collateral after Standardised Approach haircuts.

title: Interbank exposures
twin: Interbank exposures shall be reported, excluding intraday interbank exposures.

title: Output format
twin: The report shall be submitted in the prescribed LE-1 format.

title: Reconciliation
twin: Reported exposures shall be reconciled with the general ledger.
